comment: Content-Security-Policy for the app pages, written into index.html, lite.html and byo.html by tools/make_editions.py. Each outside host is here for one stated reason. When a chat Worker URL or an R2 base URL is set in web/data/edition.js, add its origin under 'connect' (chat) or 'media' and 'img' (R2), then run tools/make_editions.py. 127.0.0.1/localhost are for local tests and the R2 mock (the app only accepts those overrides on a local copy).
